hypotheses.question: Does value-blind source reconstruction recover actor/time/account ownership more reliably than equal-budget direct verification?
hypotheses.new_condition: Deterministic masked-claim query never receives selected value; compare same-wordbag bindings and a deliberately value-visible condition.
hypotheses.prior_overlap: QAGS/QAFactEval/CoVe are existing work; novelty remains unestablished. Existing local/repair readouts are not this new semantic query.

Missing original question makes comparison roles underidentified
Frozen model cannot reconstruct or validate a relation

hypotheses.question: Can a direct whole-answer source judge provide useful semantic observations without the failed extraction interface, and do its decisions depend on arbitrary answer labels?
hypotheses.new_condition: One dense next-label forward for each of all6 assignments of three semantic classes, same full18 original inputs; no generated span, offset or JSON output.
hypotheses.prior_overlap: P031 broad frozen semantic verification was proposed/unrun; H002 never issued source-verification calls. Direct verification and label permutation are established baselines, not claimed novel.
hypotheses.admission: All whole-answer cases retained. No token detector score, target-label tuning, training, semantic calibration claim or AUROC yet.
hypotheses.next: Separate typed evidence semantics, long-context/source composition and arithmetic rather than inventing method weights.
